capabilities.label: Pliron context ownership
capabilities.detail: Process-local context identities, registered dialects, and context-bound handles are checked before operations are inspected. Generic safety passes execute today; issue #140 tracks stronger owner-aware upstream arena handles rather than blocking the production verifier sequence.

capabilities.label: Generic pre-lowering safety
capabilities.detail: The mandatory workload-neutral sequence verifies ranked bounds, race freedom, barrier convergence, workgroup-memory initialization and publication, and declared semantic refinement. Rejected and Incomplete findings both stop strict production compilation before lowering.

capabilities.label: Rust production route
capabilities.detail: Ordinary safe Rust reaches semantic MIR, ranked PLIRON verification, Kernel IR, formal memory admission, gfx942 LLVM, HSACO, and qualification launch for dynamic strided GEMM, row softmax, fused attention, and grouped-expert MoE. The kernels exercise target-neutral matrix fragments, subgroup collectives, device math, runtime dimensions, edge predicates, dynamic loops, additive masks, tiled disjoint outputs, and epilogues through one workload-neutral route. Unsupported effects and ownership forms remain deliberately fail-closed.

capabilities.label: Bounded compiler analysis
capabilities.detail: Closed control-flow validation, pruned SSA placement, uniformity, sparse index facts, dynamic tiled-component reasoning, exact bounded invocation traces, and stable diagnostics feed every workload through the same safety pipeline. Pure device math and collective summaries preserve analysis facts without naming algorithms. Unsupported operations and resource limits fail closed as Incomplete obligations.

capabilities.label: Target finalization
capabilities.detail: The current qualification route emits gfx942 LLVM, links HSACO, loads it through fe2o3-host, and checks dynamic GEMM, row-softmax, fused-attention, and grouped-expert GPU results against independent CPU references. Disassembly confirms MFMA for matrix contractions and lane shuffles for reductions. The published measurements are correctness qualifications; only the GEMM lesson includes a matched direct HIP comparison, and it does not claim a speed advantage. Protected release authority and complete source-to-machine refinement remain separate.

capabilities.label: Runtime and persistent execution
capabilities.detail: Pure-Rust KFD topology, memory, queue, packet, and typed lifecycle foundations are present. Current main also completes authority-free crash-recovery mechanics for Worker V2 publication intents and predecessor cleanup through exact leases, private cleanup escrow, and restart-atomic retirement. These types explicitly grant no publication, load, or launch authority; verified persistent execution and complete production runtime authority remain open in issues #135 and #137.
